records: SBI VC Trade's current JPYSC page states customer deposits and withdrawals are unavailable. Public-chain circulation remains conditional on legal/tax clarification and regulatory confirmation; no public-chain JPYSC transaction-volume feature may be inferred.
The issuer's reserve table is as of 2026-09-30, not 2026-10-30. A secondary report of approximately JPY20.8B on 30 October is not confirmed by a current primary issuer balance in this capture.
The approximately JPY6.9B JPYSC Lending figure is applications/program activity, not additional issued supply and not a verified outstanding loan balance.

The statutory 50% investment allowance applies only to qualifying short-term government bonds/time deposits subject to requirements. The public page does not disclose all time-deposit maturities or a complete legal eligibility calculation.

SMFG's 5% participation in SBI Startale Marketing, the BlackRock tokenized-MMF MOU and the JPYSC/OUSD interoperability PoC are exploratory; no production settlement or transaction volume is established.

Circle SBI Japan K.K. (Circle/SBI JV), SBI Startale Marketing (SBI/Startale JV), SBI Ripple Asia, SBI VC Trade, SBI Shinsei Trust, SBI Holdings, SBIC East Japan and SBICAH GK are distinct entities and must not be conflated.

SBI's multi-rail relationships do not prove XRP demand. JPYSC/OUSD, USDC, RLUSD and Circle Arc can operate without native XRP as a bridge asset; no measured incremental XRP purchase or settlement flow is identified.
SBI's completed Bitbank acquisition does not establish shared order books, merged custody, common market-making inventory or consolidated XRP liquidity with SBI VC Trade.
The approximately 9% SBI Ripple equity holding is historical as of June 2025 and is not a verified current ownership percentage.

The first append files for this update used an incorrect top-level record_type and are preserved unreferenced. Corrected immutable replacements are referenced by the index. No source, run-update or limitation payload was discarded.
